Change color to black and replace the standard ribbed hem with a double-layered extended hem construction visible in the front and side views.
Change text print to solid pale pink, add a left chest pocket, introduce a high-low curved back hem, and include a center back box pleat.

b_better.text: Replace the all-over snakeskin geometric print with a solid black finish and add two diagonal zippered chest pockets.
Front: Add a structural V-insert to the neckline and switch from raglan to set-in sleeves. Back: Remove diagonal raglan seams in favor of standard shoulder construction.
Add a white pointed collar and vertical center-front placket; change short sleeves to long sleeves with functional button cuffs and switch fabric to smooth matte wool.
Front: change to a button-up shirt-jacket with a single left chest pocket. Back: add a center-back yoke and vertical seam, removing all plaid side paneling.
Replace the point collar with a band collar and add subtle gathering beneath the back yoke; simplify the hem to a straight, uniform length.
Add an integrated white shirt-tail underlayer that extends 3 inches below the main black hem, visible from both the front and side views.
Add symmetrical, contrasting synthetic material elbow patches to the sleeves, visible from the back, while keeping the front minimalist and identical to the source.
Front: remove the chest graphic for a plain finish. Back: add a signature black X-shaped detail at the center neckline.
Integrate an asymmetrical waist belt with a silver buckle at the left hip and replace the ribbed cuffs with buttoned cuff construction.
Front: Add a single left-chest pocket and golden contrast stitching. Back: Incorporate a horizontal back yoke and a raw, frayed bottom hem finish.

a_better.text: Transform the acid-wash denim button-front shirt into a gingham scoop-neck top. Replace front buttons/collar with a simple scoop neck and add a four-button back placket.
Front: replace long sleeves and crew neck with spaghetti straps and a scoop neck. Back: change to a straight-across neckline, removing sleeves and full back coverage.
Replace side cut-outs with lace panels and add a large semi-sheer floral lace panel to the entire upper back.
Convert to short sleeves, add a functional three-button henley placket, and swap the crew neckline for a wider, open scoop neckline.
Switch material to solid red French terry. Add an asymmetrical single patch pocket on the wearer's right back panel and update the hem to a clean double-needle stitch.
Add black color-blocked side panels to the front, replace cap sleeves with 3/4 length banded sleeves, and change the high-low curved hem to a straight banded hem.
Front: Introduce horizontal eyelet openwork and add a white ruffled tiered hem. Back: Include a central solid vertical knit panel flanked by diagonal openwork.
Add hood and kangaroo pocket, switch to raglan sleeves, incorporate side vents, and replace character print with horizontal text-motif stripes.
Convert the long-sleeve shirt to a sleeveless style, change to a single left chest pocket, and adopt a cropped front with a high-low hemline.
Change to a slate blue-gray longline tunic length and incorporate an architectural rectangular open-back cutout framed by a horizontal shoulder yoke.

b_better.text: Replace V-neck with studded scoop neckline, remove the side zipper, add dual side slits, and remove the vertical center back seam.
Change dark grey to dark blue acid wash, add metallic silver aglets to the drawstring, and remove the rear slash pockets for a cleaner back design.
Change front scoop neck to button-placket, back deep-V to rectangular waist cutout, and replace tapered long pants with short playsuit shorts featuring side slits.
Change color from mustard yellow to black and add a bright blue contrast band to the bottom hem.
Front: switch to V-neck and add cap sleeves. Back: change to a deep V-back design and add a vertical center-back structural seam.
Change color to lavender, replace lace side panels with functional side ties, crop the length to the navel, and remove the racerback design.
Add diamond-quilted knee panels to the front for a moto-style look and replace the rear welt pockets with a clean, pocketless design featuring only a yoke seam.
Front: Add a patch pocket to the wearer's left chest. Back: Lengthen the body into a tunic-style silhouette with an extended curved hem.
Change to spaghetti straps, empire-waist flowy skirt, and add an asymmetrical lace-up side closure on the wearer's left side.
Change to a square neckline with cord tassels, add side seam pockets, remove chest and back embroidery bands, and change back to a plain black panel.

a_better.text: Replace front embroidery with symmetrical mixed-metal stud/eyelet hardware and swap the straight midi hem for a dramatic high-low draped back construction.
Add symmetrical flap-closure cargo pockets to the thighs; update the branding label location on the waistband and adopt a utilitarian cargo-style aesthetic.
Change the notched collar to a round neckline, add two horizontal waist pockets, and incorporate a structured peplum flare at the hem.
Convert the one-shoulder gown to a sleeveless round-neck dress with a central waist knot, symmetrical side cut-outs, and a functional back keyhole closure.
Transform the distressed, oversized jacket into a clean, fitted, cropped version with a raw-edge frayed hem and fully intact, non-distressed sleeves.
Change to short cuffed sleeves and remove the back keyhole. Replace the bodice-to-hem ruffle with a three-tiered ruffle starting specifically on the wearer's left hip.
Change to navy pinstripe poplin; swap V-neck for round neck; add ruched elbow ties; replace back yoke with keyhole button closure and straight hem.
Front: replace stripe panel with two buttoned flap pockets. Back: add center-back vent and waistband button closure; change base fabric to red houndstooth tweed.
Change from blush pink to black, add a thigh-high side slit to the skirt, and replace the back keyhole with a dramatic open back and beaded central strap.
Switch to pale blush pink, simplify the front placket to a single vertical ruffle, and remove the vertical sleeve slits on the back to create continuous, closed sleeves.

b_better.text: Incorporate two large, symmetrical front patch pockets and add an asymmetrical button-and-tab closure detail to the back waistband.
Apply a coral-to-white vertical ombre gradient, add a patch pocket to the left chest, and include a small woven brand tag at the back left hem.
Transition to a navy lace bodice with three-quarter sleeves and a solid skirt. Change the back to a deep V-neckline with a functional center-back button closure.
Transition to a solid red knit fabric, remove side pockets, and add back patch pockets with asymmetrical branding on the left side.
Add belt loops, front pleats, and side pockets; update the hem with a heavy turned-up cuff and modify the waist to a tailored closure.
Add functional side-seam pockets and a center-front inverted pleat. Change the material from a matte plaid weave to a metallic-finished black and bronze houndstooth brocade.
Remove the front bow tie, add gathered ruched detailing to the lower legs, and eliminate the center back seam for a smoother seat.
Apply grey chevron print, replace crochet yoke with black geometric piping, and add a flared peplum hemline visible from both the front and back.
Change to a mixed-pattern diagonal/vertical stripe front; add horizontal striped waistband; replace clean back with an exposed center-back gold metal zipper.
Front: Add color-blocking, a cord tie closure, and fringe hem trim. Back: Replace all-over fur with a smooth, solid black panel.

a_better.text: Change to a black colorway with a metallic silver zipper and add light-colored trim to the hood edge; replace elongated sleeves with standard length.
Convert to solid black, wide-leg pleated trousers. Remove raw center seams and add a single navy satin tuxedo stripe exclusively down the wearer's left outer leg.
Change the front closure to an asymmetrical diagonal zipper and replace the smooth back panel with horizontal channel-quilted puffer padding.
Change the wide-leg silhouette to a tapered jogger fit with ribbed ankle cuffs; remove the back patch pocket for a clean, streamlined rear design.
Change to a short-sleeved, square-neckline blouse with elbow-length sleeves and a high-low hemline, all featuring frayed raw-edge detailing in a lightweight crepe fabric.
Switch from a polo collar to a button-front crew neck cardigan with a tricolor placket; add four white sleeve stripes and a back neck label.
Replace the black satin color-blocked body with a light gray horizontal quilted nylon body and substitute the grey sleeves with solid black leather.
Add white geometric diagonal panels to the chest and shoulders. Relocate the asymmetrical pocket from the jacket body to a utility zipper pocket on the left sleeve.
Add a pointed collar, button placket, and waist belt to the front; include a back yoke and adjustable sleeve tie straps to the back for a dress silhouette.
Switch to long sleeves with ribbed cuffs, apply paint-drip graphic to front/back, add asymmetrical 'OFF-WHITE' sleeve typography, and remove contrast stitching.

b_better.text: Replace all light blue accents with a continuous dark grey hem panel and switch from a band collar to a standard point collar.
Add yellow interior hood lining and bold yellow sleeve cuffs. Add a circular logo patch to the left sleeve and replace hood snaps with yellow-tipped drawstrings.
Change to a long-sleeved tunic with a mandarin collar, partial placket, curved high-low hem, and a functional side vent on the wearer's left side only.
Front: replace print with a leather-like draped panel and a raw hem. Back: add an architectural horizontal leather band on the shoulder and a center button closure.
Change to a black polo with white double-stripe trim on collar and cuffs; replace chest logo with a white embroidered graphic; maintain plain back.
Remove the front vertical zippers and asymmetrical graphic patch; add a large, vibrant, colorful arched sunburst patch to the center of the upper back.
Front: replace baroque print with textured black fabric and side mesh panels. Back: add center-back seam and keyhole neck closure. Sleeves: change to cap sleeves.
Remove the front 'DADA' chest graphic and add a small, asymmetrical text logo to the wearer's left upper back, while changing the garment color to off-white.
Change uniform vertical pleating to an all-over crinkled/embossed texture and update to dropped shoulder seams while retaining the relaxed, longline silhouette.
Incorporate functional zippered side pockets, add a center-front drawstring to the waistband, and include two symmetrical patch pockets on the back panel.
